title: supeWallet
tagline: supeWallet: An AI driven wallet that simplifies Web3 by enabling users to interact with blockchain effortlessly using natural language prompts, making DeFi accessible for everyone.
description:
supeWallet is an AI-driven wallet that makes blockchain super easy and accessible for everyone. No need to deal with confusing interfaces or learn complex blockchain stuff—just type what you want in plain language.

Whether it’s sending assets across different blockchains, minting NFTs, encrypting important files, or tokenizing real-world assets, supeWallet handles it all smoothly. It takes care of the complicated blockchain work so users can focus on what they need to do.

It’s designed to be simple enough for beginners but powerful enough for experienced users.
how_its_made:
supeWallet combines React.js for a dynamic, responsive UI with Tailwind CSS for customizable styling, Galadriel OpenAI's GPT-4 for natural language interactions . It leverages Express for efficient backend processing. It interacts directly with multiple blockchains for seamless contract deployment and transaction management, while potentially using IPFS for decentralized storage solutions.

We have also used:

CHAINLINK
•	Cross-Chain Digital Asset Transfer (Powered by Chainlink CCIP):
supeWallet makes it easy for users to send digital assets between different blockchains. You can move tokens within the same chain or across multiple chains by just giving a simple prompt, thanks to Chainlink CCIP.
•	Minting NFTs:
Users can ask AI models to generate NFTs with the help of Chainlink Functions. These NFTs can be minted across different chains using Chainlink CCIP.

LIT PROTOCOL
•	Wallet Options:
supeWallet gives users the flexibility to choose between their own wallet or the integrated PKP Wallet. The PKP Wallet allows you to programmatically execute transactions, giving you more security and control over your interactions.
•	Encrypted File Transfer (For example: AI datasets and weights):
You can upload and encrypt confidential files before sending them. Lit Protocol ensures that only authorized people can decrypt the files based on conditions you set using LitActions.

HEDERA BLOCKCHAIN
•	Tokenization of Real-World Assets:
Users can tokenize real-world assets like property or certificates by uploading their details. This happens on the Hedera blockchain, and asset owners can transfer these tokenized assets by providing the token ID and the recipient's Hedera account ID.
•	For Cross-chain NFT transfer
